name: Release Manager
tagline: Takes one track from final audio to released single, checklist step by checklist step.
description: Give it the finished audio and it manages the road to a real release: a lyric video and Shorts cut for YouTube, the upload through your distributor, a pitch to Spotify's editors and the no-cost promo moves in between. It works through the checklist sequentially, so an independent artist always knows what comes next.
author: PaulHPowell13
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
